plugin.name: SOCOM Fireteam Bravo 2 PPSSPP Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup message boxes when the game version provides them. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
DualAnalogPatch.description: Enable right-stick aiming and camera controls. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
UnthrottleEmuDuringLoading.description: Unthrottle the emulator during loading and restore normal throttling when loading threads finish. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
